title: Implement genuine per-file deselection while other torrent files continue
description:
Fork research: parallel GPT-6 Astra source reviews, 2026-10-25. Current application baseline: 3ae404b.

## Purpose and evidence

Simple Torrent implements StopFile via file priority. Current engine.StopFile returns unsupported; closed #65 correctly removed its misleading UI. This new feature supplies real deselection before offering a control, extending rather than reopening #65. Use Skip/deselect terminology because BitTorrent pieces may cross file boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

- Allow deselecting an exact file that belongs to the torrent, stop requesting its unique pieces, and keep selected siblings downloading. Define the all-files-skipped state and permit re-selection.
- Keep UI/API/model state consistent and persist selection across in-process reconfiguration and process restart. Reintroduce no enabled control until the backend supports it.
- Never delete skipped data or promise zero incidental bytes in a skipped file. Account for shared pieces and outstanding writes in the existing active-file/ancestor deletion protections.
- Reject unknown, aliased or escaping paths and retain engine locking/ownership invariants.
- Use an isolated multifile webseed fixture with shared boundary pieces to verify actual requests/content and sibling progress, skip/reselect, all-skipped behavior, invalid paths and restart persistence.

## Sources

- https://github.com/boypt/simple-torrent/blob/6f4942933b71106bae00b4f4c94438e3b315fca2/engine/engine.go#L452-L488
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/engine/engine.go#L453-L486
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/engine/files.go

## Scope

Implement within the existing Go engine, typed API, generated frontend models and authenticated handler chain. Use isolated legal fixtures; never test against live downloads. This is a new backlog item, not a claim that the proposed behavior already exists.

## Prerequisites

#76.
